versions.changelog:
- Initial release of lingxiao-image-generate for automated e-commerce product image creation.
- Supports generating master images, scene images, model images, and white background product images with tailored prompts.
- Integrates with Lingxiao MCP for per-image billing; requires personal account and API key for image generation.
- Functions include checking available models, per-image pricing, and account balance before generation.
- Ensures image quality consistency and handles automatic model fallback with clear billing reporting.
- Guidance provided on crafting effective prompts and when to use/avoid AI-generated images for e-commerce.
